goalZh: 会读三位数、四位数的价格,听懂 per night 和 plus tax,问清楚包不包括早餐
canDoZh: 能听懂和说出三位数以上的价格,问清楚每晚多少钱、含不含税

newItems.noteZh: $189 per night 每晚 189 美元;口语更常说 a night:$189 a night。读 /pɝː/,要卷舌。
plus tax 另加税;美国的标价一般不含税,听到 plus tax 就知道最后要多付一些。u 读 /ʌ/。
Does that include breakfast? 含早餐吗?;问价格包不包括什么就用它。重音在后 in-CLUDE。
The total is $424. 一共 424 美元;中间的 t 读闪音,像“TOE-dl”。
$212 for each room 每间房 212 美元;each 后面跟单数名词。读长音 /iːtʃ/,别读成 itch。
不可数名词:a lot of money(不说 moneys);o 读 /ʌ/。
How much does it cost? 要多少钱?;和 How much is it? 意思一样。过去式还是 cost,美式 o 读 /ɑː/。
读 /swiːt/,和 sweet(甜的)同音,不读成 suit;套房比普通房间大,一般带客厅。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: I love LA! One more night here?
lines.zh: (第三天早上)我太喜欢洛杉矶了!要不要再住一晚?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hi. How much is one more night?
lines.zh: (磊打给前台)你好,再住一晚要多少钱?

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: It's 189 dollars per night, plus tax.
lines.zh: 每晚 189 美元,另外加税。

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: No, it doesn't. With tax, it's about 212 dollars for each room.
lines.zh: 不含。加上税,每间房大约 212 美元。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: So the total is 424 dollars? That's a lot of money!
lines.zh: 那两间一共就是 424 美元?好多钱啊!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: And how much does the big suite on the top floor cost?
lines.zh: (开玩笑地)那顶楼的大套房多少钱?

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: That one is 1,250 dollars a night.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Wow, that's too expensive! Could we check out at twelve on Thursday?
lines.zh: 哇,太贵了!那我们周四能十二点退房吗?

questions.prompt: 多住一晚,每间房含税大约多少钱?
questions.explainZh: 前台说 189 dollars per night, plus tax,含税 about 212 dollars for each room;424 美元是两间房加起来的总数。
磊问 Does that include breakfast?,前台说 No, it doesn't.。

options: 不多住了,周四十二点退房
questions.explainZh: 磊说 that's too expensive,又问 Could we check out at twelve on Thursday?,前台说可以。

grammar.bodyZh: 三位数先读几百,再读后面两位:189 = one hundred eighty-nine,424 = four hundred twenty-four。美式英语 hundred 后面一般不加 and(英式说 one hundred and eighty-nine)。说价格时口语常省掉 hundred,拆成两段读:$189 读 one eighty-nine,$212 读 two twelve,和第 4 单元的 sixteen fifty 一个道理。四位数用 thousand:1,250 = one thousand two hundred fifty;写的时候每三位加一个逗号(1,250),不是小数点。hundred、thousand 前面有数字时不加 s:two hundred dollars,不说 two hundreds dollars。发音:hundred /ˈhʌndrəd/ 里的 dr 连在一起,不要加元音;thousand 的 th 是清音 /θ/。

examples.zh: 每晚 189 美元。(one hundred eighty-nine 或 one eighty-nine)
一共 424 美元。(four hundred twenty-four)

examples.text: That one is 1,250 dollars a night.
examples.zh: 那间一晚 1,250 美元。(one thousand two hundred fifty)

grammar.bodyZh: 问价格还有几种常见说法:① 每晚、每小时用 per 或 a:189 dollars per night = 189 dollars a night,口语更常用 a;② plus tax 是“另外加税”,美国的标价一般不含销售税(第 4 单元的菜单也是这样),结账时会多出一些;③ 问包不包括某样东西:Does that include breakfast?,回答 Yes, it does. / No, it doesn't.。问“……多少钱”可以说 How much is…?,也可以说 How much does … cost?——用 cost 时前面要有 does,cost 用原形。

examples.text: It's 189 dollars a night, plus tax.
examples.zh: 每晚 189 美元,另外加税。

examples.text: Does that include breakfast? — No, it doesn't.
How much does the suite cost?
